self.title: Set it up myself
self.body: Follow a short guide. You'll create a private app in Shopify and paste two keys here.

step1.title: Open Develop apps in Shopify
step1.body: In your Shopify admin, go to Settings → Apps and sales channels → Develop apps.

step2.title: Create an app called Traced
step2.body: Click Create an app, name it Traced, then confirm.

step3.title: Add the app URL
step3.body: In the app's configuration, set the App URL to:

step4.title: Embed the app in Shopify admin
step4.body: Turn on "Embed app in Shopify admin".

step5.title: Set the webhook API version
step5.body: Under Webhooks, set the API version to:

step6.title: Add the API access scopes
step6.body: Under API access scopes, add all of these:

step7.title: Leave legacy install flow off
step7.body: Keep "Use legacy install flow" set to false — leave it as it is.

step9.title: Release and install
step9.body: Click Release, then install the app on your store.

step10.title: Connect your store
step10.body: Get your store domain from Settings → Domains (your primary .myshopify.com domain). Copy the Client ID and Client Secret from the app's settings. Paste all three below.
step10.secure: Your keys are encrypted and used only to sync your store.

guide.title: Find your store address
guide.s1Body: On a computer, sign in to Shopify and open your store: the page where you see orders and products.
guide.s2Body: Click the address bar at the top of the browser and copy everything in it.
guide.s2Tip: Copy with Ctrl + C on Windows or ⌘ + C on a Mac. The part after /store/ is your store's name.
guide.s3Body: Paste the address you copied. We'll find your store from it.
guide.phoneBody: In the Shopify app, go to Settings › Domains. Your store address ends in .myshopify.com. Copy it and paste it here.
guide.phoneTip: Use the one ending in .myshopify.com, not your own website address.
